Name: Arista, Wand of the Spire
Description: Arista, Wand of the Spire is a artifact magical wand with charges or limited uses that produce a powerful spell-like or supernatural effect.

Name: Armor of Absence
Description: Armor of Absence is an artifact magical defensive item with powerful protective, reactive, movement, or environmental properties associated with its enchantment.

Name: Axe of the Dwarvish Lords
Description: This artifact battleaxe grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls. While attuned, it also grants powerful dwarven traits and defenses, including enhanced Constitution, darkvision, and resistance to poison; like other major artifacts, it also carries additional beneficial and detrimental properties.

Name: Blackrazor
Description: This sentient +3 greatsword hungers for souls. When it reduces a qualifying creature to 0 hit points, it devours that creature's soul and grants the wielder temporary hit points based on the victim's vitality; while those temporary hit points remain, the wielder gains major combat benefits. It can also sense nearby living creatures.

Name: Book of Exalted Deeds
Description: A good-aligned creature that studies this holy artifact and meets its requirements gains powerful lasting blessings, including improved Wisdom and enhanced sacred magic. The book contains exalted lore, may bestow additional beneficial properties, and rejects or harms unworthy readers.

Name: Book of Vile Darkness
Description: An evil creature that studies this artifact can gain lasting corrupting benefits, including increased ability scores and access to vile lore. The book also carries harmful and corruptive effects, additional artifact properties, and severe consequences for creatures that are not sufficiently evil.

Name: Calimemnon Crystal
Description: Calimemnon Crystal is a artifact magical focus or object that stores, reveals, enhances, or releases a powerful supernatural effect.

Name: Criir's Blade
Description: Criir's Blade is an artifact magical weapon with potent combat properties, such as enhanced attacks, additional damage, special conditions, or limited activated abilities.

Name: Criir's Scepter
Description: Criir's Scepter is a artifact magical rod with a potent activated utility, control, defensive, or combat effect.

Name: Crown Of Horns
Description: Crown Of Horns is an artifact magical wondrous item with powerful utility, defensive, movement, control, or combat-related supernatural properties.

Name: Demonomicon of Iggwilv
Description: This artifact tome contains extensive lore on demons and the Abyss. An attuned wielder gains powerful abilities for identifying, controlling, binding, and banishing fiends, but the book's magic is dangerous and can expose its bearer to demonic corruption and hostile forces.

Name: Eye and Hand of Vecna
Description: These paired artifacts require replacing your own eye and hand to attune. Each grants powerful supernatural abilities and spell-like effects, with even greater powers when both are used together; destroying or abusing them carries extreme risks, including corruption and possible loss of control.

Name: Sword of Kas
Description: This sentient +3 longsword is especially potent against Vecna and creatures tied to him. It grants strong combat and defensive benefits, can produce powerful spell-like effects, and has its own violent personality and goals.

Name: Wand of Orcus
Description: This sentient artifact mace-like wand grants a +3 bonus to attacks, deals additional necrotic damage, and can summon undead or cast powerful necromancy. It has its own malevolent will and is exceptionally dangerous in the hands of Orcus or another evil wielder.

Name: Wave
Description: This sentient +3 trident is devoted to a sea god. It functions as a powerful magic weapon, can confer aquatic and divinatory benefits, and on a critical hit deals devastating extra necrotic damage based on the target's maximum hit points.

Name: Whelm
Description: This sentient +3 warhammer is strongly tied to dwarves. It can be thrown and return to its wielder, deals increased damage to certain giant foes, and can release a powerful stunning shockwave; it also grants additional senses underground.
